name: priority_encoder4to2
description: Four-input priority encoder with valid indication.

ports.name: request_i
ports.role: Request vector; bit 3 has the highest priority.

ports.name: code_o
ports.role: Encoded index of the highest asserted request.

ports.name: valid_o
ports.role: High when at least one request is asserted.

expected_behavior: Encodes the highest asserted request_i bit.
Drives valid_o low when request_i is zero.
